newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 106.5 Jan 24 wk.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 106.5 Jan 24 wk.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose to 106.5 in the week ended January 24 from a revised 106.3 the prior week, ECRI said.
The growth rate of real estate loans rose, helping to push up the index, ECRI said. The yield spread between 10-year and three-month Treasuries widened, moderating the rise, it said.
"While disinflationary pressures have dissipated, inflationary pressures have not yet risen enough to signal a cyclical upturn in inflation," ECRI said.
